cases.raw: $A-\lambda I=\begin{pmatrix}2-\lambda&1\\1&2-\lambda\end{pmatrix}$, and for a $2\times2$ matrix $\det\begin{pmatrix}p&q\\r&s\end{pmatrix}=ps-qr$. So $$\det(A-\lambda I)=(2-\lambda)^2-1\cdot1=\lambda^2-4\lambda+3.$$ Its roots $\lambda=1,3$ are the eigenvalues. Option $b$ drops the minus sign in $ps-qr$; $c$ subtracts the constant incorrectly; $d$ flips the sign of the linear term.

cases.raw: 对 $2\times2$ 矩阵 $A=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$，以下哪组关于行列式的说法全都正确？
cases.oldDisplay: 对 $2\times2$ 矩阵 $A=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\c&d\end{pmatrix}$，以下哪组关于行列式的说法全都正确？

cases.raw:
雅可比矩阵按“第 $i$ 行 = 第 $i$ 个分量对所有自变量的偏导”排布：
$$
J_{\mathbf F}=
\begin{pmatrix}
\dfrac{\partial (xy)}{\partial x} & \dfrac{\partial (xy)}{\partial y}\\[6pt]
\dfrac{\partial (x+y^2)}{\partial x} & \dfrac{\partial (x+y^2)}{\partial y}
\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
y & x\\
1 & 2y
\end{pmatrix}.
$$
注意 $\partial(xy)/\partial x=y$（$y$ 当常数），$\partial(xy)/\partial y=x$。转置形式 $\begin{pmatrix}y&1\\x&2y\end{pmatrix}$ 把偏导排成了列；$\begin{pmatrix}y&x\\2y&1\end{pmatrix}$ 把第二行的两个分量次序调换了；$\begin{pmatrix}x&y\\1&2y\end{pmatrix}$ 把第一行的 $x,y$ 位置写反了。

cases.raw: Pada $(x,y)=(1,0)$, $H=(1,1)$. Jacobian $G$ di $(1,1)$ adalah $\begin{pmatrix}2u&1\\v&u\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$, sedangkan $J_H=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$. Aturan rantai dengan konvensi ini memberi $J_{G\circ H}=J_G(H(x,y))J_H(x,y)$, yakni $\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\2&0\end{pmatrix}$.

cases.raw:
Vektor eigen memenuhi $(A-\lambda I)v=0$. Untuk $\lambda=2$:
$$(A-2I)v=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}v_1\\v_2\end{pmatrix}=0\;\Rightarrow\;v_1+v_2=0\;\Rightarrow\;v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\-1\end{pmatrix}$$
(bisa dikali skalar berapa pun). Cek: $Av=\begin{pmatrix}3-1\\-2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2\\-2\end{pmatrix}=2v$. Perhatikan $v=(1,0)$ adalah vektor eigen untuk $\lambda=3$, bukan $\lambda=2$.

cases.raw: For a $2\times2$ matrix $A=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$, which statement correctly links its determinant to area scaling and invertibility?

cases.raw:
First evaluate the Jacobian of $F$ at $(1,2)$:
$$
J_F(x,y)=\begin{pmatrix}2x&1\\y&x\end{pmatrix},\qquad J_F(1,2)=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\2&1\end{pmatrix}.
$$
The velocity is $\gamma'(1)=(1,2)$. The chain rule gives
$$
\frac{d}{dt}F(\gamma(t))\bigg|_{t=1}=J_F(1,2)\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}4\\4\end{pmatrix}.
$$
Wait, recomputing the component derivatives directly: $F(\gamma(t))=(t^2+(1+t^2),\ t(1+t^2))=(1+2t^2,t+t^3)$, whose derivative at $1$ is $(4,4)$. The listed options do not include this value, so this question is invalid.

cases.raw: For $F=(F_1,F_2)$, each row contains the partial derivatives of one output component: $J_F=\begin{pmatrix}\partial F_1/\partial x&\partial F_1/\partial y\\\partial F_2/\partial x&\partial F_2/\partial y\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2x&1\\y&x\end{pmatrix}$. Substituting $(x,y)=(1,2)$ gives $\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\2&1\end{pmatrix}$.

cases.raw: Para uma matriz $2\times2$, $\det\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}=ad-bc$. Logo, $\det(C)=2\cdot3-1\cdot5=1$. O determinante é o fator assinado de escala de área: valor absoluto $1$ preserva área, e sinal positivo indica que a orientação não é invertida. Como o determinante é diferente de zero, $C$ é invertível.

cases.raw: La regla de la cadena es $D(F\circ g)=DF(g(s,t))Dg(s,t)$. Aquí $g(1,2)=(3,2)$, $DF(u,v)=\begin{pmatrix}2u&1\\v&u\end{pmatrix}$ y $Dg(s,t)=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\t&s\end{pmatrix}$. Así, $\begin{pmatrix}6&1\\2&3\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\2&1\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}8&7\\8&5\end{pmatrix}$.
